decisions.statement: The base is a plain distro rather than an image with NVIDIA libraries.
The base tag fixes the version of every package from that release pocket.
No package from the base pocket has a version of its own.
A version is pinned where the version is a real choice.
The build proves on disk every file the rig cannot start without.
The build proves on disk every binary the rig cannot start without.
No GPU reading is taken at build time.
The builder has no card and no injected driver.
